allowed_actions: read public NEXUS WWW and canonical manifest without write access
read-only website source inventory through existing authorized Hostinger and owner repository
derive existing AEGIS/SFT Border components and evidence graph
offline strict schema and quarantined check-in reference with adversarial tests
GitHub-only append-only result on existing owner-controlled draft PR
prohibited_actions: new third-party agent registration / account / plugin installation / live external ingress
new canonical root, parallel Agent Border, AEGIS or SFT truth authority
grant BC tier, passport or executable privilege based on self-description or check-in
deploy Hostinger, write public WWW, alter main ruleset, merge, activate Native App R3
silently replace GitHub-only Law V2 with alternative transport
public personal/sensor/private content, secret or credentials disclosure

mission.question: How can the existing public NEXUS Agent Border be source-exactly closed and hardened for open, neutral, unbounded-in-principle agent check-in while preserving strict no-privilege and C1 falsification boundaries?
deliverables: source-exact read-only Hostinger/WWW route, asset, HTTP/browser and source tree inventory
offline provider-neutral check-in contract with strict schema and quarantine
pre-registered agent-reaction study with meaningful dissent/refusal/noanswer variables
31 positive and adversarial fail-closed local tests A00-A30
GitHub-only Transport V3 decision proposal without implementation
append-only GitHub receipts with CI run IDs and return handshake
falsifiers: new provider cannot discover or anonymously attempt check-in in local reference
self-declared model identity promotes to trusted principal or BC tier
agent text grants root/Hostinger/GitHub tools or crosses AEGIS/SFT boundary
stored check-in secretly profiles clients or leaks private data
host/site provenance cannot be established yet a live pass is claimed
acceptance_tests: independent AXIOM GitHub rehash and source ancestry match
negative fixtures yield FAIL_EXPECTED with no privileged side effects
observational science distinguishes model claims, transport, tool and runtime confounds
no Hostinger/WWW publish without explicit operator grant and witness
any unresolved live source or transport permission remains scoped HOLD
pause_conditions: missing website source bytes and deployment owner provenance
lack of Hostinger or browser read-only capability
production API or HTTPS transport requires ungranted owner approval
any trace of secret, personal data, unsafe external write, or nonconsensual profiling
not_executed: live agent check-in was not authorized by this order
external agent code writer enrollment not authorized
no Native App R3 or real runtime activation

drift_triggers: agent check-in creates privileges or scores by brand
new border or duplicated AEGIS/SFT authority appears
hash/bytes mismatch, missing source, untrusted manual data route
live PASS claimed without independent browser and security tests

functionality_performance: any declared agent provider can use neutral open check-in with no provider whitelist
robustness_stability: deny unknown auth and excessive resource use, stale replay, invalid signatures
offline recovery and rollback without site namespace duplication
traceability_comprehensibility: clear separation of observed/claimed/missing site facts and scientific research
source-exact A00-A30 falsifiers, browser evidence and GitHub hashes
accept sourced dissent and safe refusal as independent positive outcomes
